architecture-review.json.review: Workbench retains strict interactive and inherited decoding; only common pure proposal restoration and result checks are shared. No new project reference, module dependency, registration, query, process, runtime partial or lock is introduced. The inherited codec has 10 source members in one cohesive 117-line validation/translation owner; retain it rather than split trivial stages. Two pre-existing codec/result size findings changed because their explicit common overloads were added. Existing one module cycle, five type cycles and 204 diagnostics remain unchanged and are not clean-solution evidence. Direct builds and selected runtime proof must be evaluated separately.

validation.cause: Strict constructor decoding requires chatSessionId and authorityId, while the background AgentToolSessionReference wire intentionally omits default values.
